instruction: Summarize these system design notes and identify the main tradeoffs.
body: The service receives requests through a queue. Workers read immutable configuration and write results to a separate store. A bounded queue limits memory use, but a small capacity can increase waiting time. Record latency and failures separately. Recovery must preserve completed work without processing the same item twice.

instruction: Turn these garden observations into a practical weekly plan.
body: The raised beds receive morning sunlight and shade after lunch. The sandy section dries faster than the clay section. Water was applied near the roots to avoid wet leaves. The gardener recorded soil moisture before watering and inspected the paths after rain. The plan should account for changing weather and available time.

instruction: Explain the code and review the surrounding implementation notes.
Extract the constraints and propose a delivery schedule from these notes.
body: A warehouse groups packages by destination before loading vehicles. Fragile items require separate handling. The morning route has a narrow arrival window while the afternoon route allows flexible unloading. A delayed shipment should not block unrelated packages. Record estimated and actual arrival times and explain any assumptions in the schedule.

instruction: Explain the experiment and distinguish observations from possible explanations.
body: Students placed equal volumes of water in containers with different exposed surface areas. They recorded mass at regular intervals and kept the room temperature as steady as possible. Airflow was not perfectly controlled. A change in mass suggests evaporation, but the measurement uncertainty must also be considered. A follow-up experiment should change one variable at a time.

instruction: 请整理以下会议记录，列出决定、待办事项和未解决的问题。
body: 团队讨论了文档更新、功能验证和发布安排。开发人员建议先补充边界用例，再评估运行速度。测试人员希望保留失败日志，方便复现。产品人员要求区分必须完成的工作与可以延后的改进。每项待办都应注明负责人、完成条件和依赖事项，暂未确认的信息需要明确标注。

instruction: 请根据以下图书馆记录，提出清晰的整理方案。
body: 阅览室按照主题摆放图书，并为新书设置临时展示区。部分读者希望按作者检索，另一些读者更关注难度和适读年龄。管理员发现有些书籍标签模糊，但借阅记录仍然完整。整理时应先核对编号，再修复标签，避免为了调整书架而改变原有借阅关系。

instruction: 请提取记录中的项目、状态和下一步操作，并用表格呈现。
body: 第一项设备已经完成检查，等待录入结果。第二项设备缺少配件，需要核对库存。第三项设备仍在运行，暂时无法安排停机检查。记录中的预计日期不是实际完成日期。若缺少明确负责人，请标为待确认，不要自行补充。整理后需要保留原始记录供工作人员核查。

instruction: 请根据这些虚构的出行记录设计行程，并说明取舍。
body: 同行者希望上午参观展览，下午在公园散步。两处地点之间需要换乘，午餐时间还未确定。有人更看重休息时间，有人希望增加活动。计划应预留交通余量，并提供下雨时的替代安排。这些记录仅用于讨论行程结构，不涉及真实营业时间、票价或预订。

instruction: 请解释以下算法学习笔记，并给出适合初学者的例子。
body: 二分查找要求数据满足相应的有序条件。每一步比较中间元素，然后缩小候选区间。实现时需要明确区间端点是否包含，防止漏掉最后一个元素。重复值会影响返回哪个位置，但不改变查找存在性的基本目标。测试应覆盖空数组、单元素数组、首尾位置和不存在的目标。
